# Reporting a security issue

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/steph4n-gh/libhighs_turbo/security/advisories/new)
for suspected vulnerabilities. Include the affected version or commit, a minimal
reproduction, the expected and observed behavior, and the impact. Do not include
credentials, private application data, or unrelated sensitive information.

Use [ordinary issues](https://github.com/steph4n-gh/libhighs_turbo/issues/new/choose)
for installation problems, feature requests, and non-security solver defects.
Incorrect accepted certificates should include the original model and witness
when these can be shared safely; use private reporting if disclosure creates a
security risk.

The [API contract](../API_CONTRACT.md) documents numerical versus exact results,
input limits, and cooperative time budgets. This reporting guide does not
promise a response deadline or long-term maintenance of older releases.
